maker: Shenzhen Legend Robot Technology Co., Ltd.
name: Legend Robot LQ05A latex paint spraying robot (3.3 m)
summary: Wheeled interior robot with a lifting mast and a six-axis arm that sprays latex paint airless onto walls and ceilings up to 3.3 m, spraying while it moves. Paint-only sister of the LQ00C putty and paint robot; one operator runs up to three units.

germany.statusNote: No German or EU seller found; enquiries go to the maker in Shenzhen (quote form, e-mail, WhatsApp). Legend Robot says it previewed its latex paint and putty spraying robot at BATIMAT 2026 in Paris with its "European partner ROBOSWISS AG" and that the system is engineered to EU CE standards, but the article does not name the model and no European sales page or price was found.

notes: Omnidirectional chassis with zero turning radius, lifting mechanism and 6-DOF arm; sprays walls, ceilings and corners (maker). Drive described as a chassis; wheels assumed.
Sprays while moving (mobile spraying) or from fixed points; airless; LiDAR obstacle avoidance and rubber crash strips.
Latex paint only; for putty Legend offers the LQ00C (3.3 m) and LQ06A (6.2 m).
runtimeH is one battery; two batteries are supplied.
